description: This file defines an abstract repository interface for managing notes, including methods for observing, creating, updating, deleting, and syncing notes within a Flutter application.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for notes data operations, including observing notes, creating, updating, deleting, and syncing notes.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a stream of note lists filtered by a query string.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a stream of a single note identified by its ID.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns a listenable object representing the current synchronization status.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content, returning its ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note identified by the given ID.
